verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java under one API key, plus a C# package. It also shows a working Python SDK code sample (client.parsing.parse) and official GitHub packages (llama-cloud for Python, @llamaindex/llama-cloud for npm). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and parity across languages, since the evidence is all first-party and the packages recently changed and require migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: One API key, with SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java.
Python: pip install llama-cloud>=1.0 ... TypeScript: npm install @llamaindex/llama-cloud
